hero.title: Fuel, care and service you can count on
hero.intro: Visit our stations in Amchit and Byblos for fuel, car wash and lube change, or have petroleum products delivered to your door.

about.title: About Us
about.heading: Who are we?
about.content: Byblos Petroleum Company (BYPEC) S.A.R.L is a leading trading company, distributing and storing various petroleum lubricants products. We offer wholesale Diesel, fuel, oil and other petroleum products to both residential and commercial establishments.

prices.title: Today's fuel prices
prices.intro: Official maximum retail prices set by the Ministry of Energy and Water, per 20 litres.

items.name: Youssef Ziade
items.quote: I had my car serviced (wash, general service) at Bypec - Amchit branch. The service was exceptional; the staff was extremely friendly and accommodating. Meanwhile, I waited for my car at the Cake & Bake adjacent to the station, where the staff was also excellent and the food was great. It is safe to say I have become a regular at Bypec. Their service, in my eyes, is unmatched!

items.name: Nohad Sleiman
items.quote: People change, locations change. But some habits don't.

services.title: Our Services
services.intro: From the pump to your doorstep.

items.title: Car wash
items.text: All of our stations are equipped with quality washing products and skilled staff to ensure efficiency and satisfaction of our customers.

items.title: Petroleum Distribution
items.text: Our company has six distribution trucks of various sizes that cover different terrains and are able to reach almost all remote destinations.

items.title: Lube Change
items.text: Bypec offers high quality British Petroleum Oils (BP) of different grades and functionalities.
